states-and-identity.rationale: Compare distinctions between states and individuals in Milton, plate 32[35]. A political meaning of state must be tested in each context; this expansion does not equate mental states with polities.

nation-and-generation.rationale: Locate nation and generation vocabulary separately before testing a relationship. Marriage's printing-house episode uses generation to generation; national passages need contextual comparison.

eternity-and-time.rationale: Juxtapose temporal vocabulary and the Proverbs of Hell rather than treating eternity, generation and emanation as synonyms.

contraries-and-negation.rationale: Compare the progression passage in Marriage with later negation passages. Their difference is a question for close reading, not an identity asserted by the index.

vision-and-fourfold.rationale: Use the letter to Thomas Butts of 22 November 1802 as a checking lead. No automatic one-to-four political model follows from these tokens. That letter is absent from the demonstration excerpts.

albion-and-jerusalem.rationale: Find name occurrences without conflating Jerusalem the work, city, personification or hymn. Work identity comes only from work_id, never from a title mention.

federation-hypothesis.rationale: Modern research hypothesis only. Expanded states/nations hits are textual testing leads, never occurrences of federation or evidence of an established Blakean federal doctrine. Run word searches for federal and federation separately.
